---
description: Naming conventions for components, files, variables, constants, and types
applyTo: '**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}'
---

# Naming Conventions

## Components

- PascalCase function declarations: `function HomeScreen()`
- Component files: PascalCase

## Files

- Component files: PascalCase: `HomeScreen.tsx`
- Utility files: kebab-case: `api-client.ts`

## Variables

- camelCase for variables and function parameters

## Constants

- UPPER_SNAKE_CASE

## Types

- PascalCase
